visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black blazer and white T-shirt stands in a brightly lit office kitchen area. He holds a glass filled with ice cubes and gestures towards a black Philips LatteGo coffee machine. The background shows a white cabinet, an air conditioner, and some boxed items on the floor. (2) Close-up of the coffee machine's touch panel as fingers select the iced coffee option. The machine begins to dispense dark brown coffee directly over the ice in a tall glass. Liquid swirls and mixes with the clear ice cubes, showing the coffee filling the container. (3) The man holds a clear container of milk and prepares the LatteGo milk frothing attachment. He snaps the container onto the front of the black coffee machine. He points at the machine with his right hand, explaining the simplicity of the process while looking at the camera. (4) Extreme close-up of the milk frothing process. Thick, white milk foam is poured into a glass cup. Following the milk, a stream of espresso enters the cup, creating distinct layers of dark brown coffee, creamy tan liquid, and thick white foam at the top. (5) The man stands with a glass of iced coffee in one hand and a latte in the other. He smiles broadly, takes a sip of the latte, and gives a satisfied expression. Pink heart graphics appear over his face. He continues gesturing toward the drinks in his hands. (6) A static shot of the Philips coffee machine on the wooden-topped counter is followed by the man returning to the frame, holding both drinks and encouraging the audience to take action.

The speaker's tone is friendly and enthusiastic, with a high arousal level. The audio is crisp and clearly recorded. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a scene transition. The BGM remains steady in the background as the speaker continues his narration with consistent volume and clear articulation. (3) The acoustic focus shifts to incidental noises of the coffee machine grinding beans and high-pressure water extraction. These mechanical sounds are rhythmic and percussive, layered under the speaker's voice and the continuous BGM. (4) Distinct liquid pouring and milk frothing sounds occur. A 'ding' sound effect highlights key promotional points on screen. The narrator's pitch rises when expressing satisfaction, adding to the positive valence of the segment.
